paragraphs.text: Cities have always kept careful records of their buildings, roads and pipes, but until recently few of them could say how many trees they owned. A tree inventory is simply a list of every publicly owned tree, with its position, species, size and condition. The first attempts date from the early twentieth century, when park departments in several European cities began recording their street trees in large ledgers. The idea was sound, but the practice was not: once a ledger was complete it was rarely updated, and within a decade or two the records described a city that no longer existed. Trees had died, been felled or been planted, and nobody had written any of it down. Most of these early inventories quietly fell out of use, and the modern interest in counting trees had to begin again almost from nothing.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The main reason cities count trees today is money. Trees provide services that can be measured and priced: shade lowers the cost of cooling buildings, canopies catch rainfall and reduce the risk of flooding, and roots stabilise soil on slopes. Computer models can turn an inventory into an estimate of the yearly value of these services, and a mature street tree in a hot city may be worth several hundred pounds a year. Without knowing what trees exist, a parks department finds it hard to argue for the budget needed to look after them. There is also a less obvious reason. A falling branch can injure a person or damage a car, and a city that keeps a record of when each tree was last inspected can show in court that it took reasonable care.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The traditional method of gathering the data has changed little in a hundred years. A crew walks the streets, notes the location of each tree, measures the trunk with a tape at a height of 1.3 metres, and records the species and any visible problems. An experienced inspector can manage perhaps a hundred trees a day, so a city with 300,000 street trees needs several years to complete a single count, and by the time it is finished the earliest records are already out of date. Newer techniques promise to speed this up. Vehicles fitted with laser scanners can map the shape of every tree along a route, and aerial or satellite images can measure the total canopy of a district. These methods are fast, but they identify the canopy, not the species, and they say nothing about the condition of an individual tree. A visit on foot is still required for that.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some cities have tried to solve the labour problem by opening the inventory to residents. Volunteers download an app, walk their own street and add each tree they find, and thousands of trees can be recorded in a single weekend. The results have been mixed. A study comparing volunteer and professional records in one North American city found that the two groups agreed on the species of a tree in about four cases out of five, and that their measurements of the trunk were usually within a few centimetres of each other. Condition, however, was a different matter. Volunteers tended to judge the same trees as being in much better health than the professionals did, perhaps because a tree that is still standing looks healthy to an untrained eye. The researchers concluded that volunteers could be relied on for a tree’s location and species, but that assessing its health still required a professional visit.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Once an inventory exists, it usually reveals two things a city did not know about itself. The first is that its trees are unevenly shared. In almost every city that has published a count, the districts with the highest incomes have the most tree cover, and the poorest districts, which suffer most from summer heat, have the least. The second is that a city often depends on a surprisingly small number of species. In one European capital, a quarter of all street trees belonged to a single genus, which is exactly the situation that allowed elm disease to strip the avenues of many cities in the last century. Foresters now recommend that no more than 10% of a city’s trees should belong to one species, no more than 20% to one genus and no more than 30% to one family. With the numbers in hand, a city can plan new planting in the districts that have the fewest trees and reduce its dependence on the species it has too many of.
paragraphs.label: E

paragraphs.text: An inventory has clear limits. It normally covers only the trees that a city owns, and in many places the majority of the urban canopy grows in private gardens, on railway land or in the grounds of hospitals and schools. A precise count of street trees may therefore say rather little about the trees of the city as a whole. The deeper challenge, as the ledgers of the last century showed, is keeping the records current. A tree inventory is not a project with an end date but a process, and the cities that have made it work treat it that way: some now re-survey each district on a rolling cycle, returning to every tree roughly once in five years. Their maps are never finished, and that, they would say, is precisely the point.
paragraphs.label: F

topic.en: What the text is about: why cities count their trees, how it is done and what the numbers reveal.
topic.kk: Мәтін не туралы: қалалар ағаштарын неге санайды, оны қалай жасайды және бұл есеп нені көрсетеді.
topic.ru: О чём текст: зачем города считают свои деревья, как это делают и что показывают такие подсчёты.

items.quote: The main reason cities count trees today is money.

explanation.en: The opening sentence states the theme: “The main reason cities count trees today is money”, and the rest of the paragraph is about value and budgets → ii “worth paying for”. Heading vii, about diseases, comes from a different paragraph and does not appear in B.
explanation.kk: Бірінші сөйлем тақырыпты айқындайды: «The main reason cities count trees today is money». Абзацтың қалған бөлігі ағаштардың құны мен бюджет туралы → ii «worth paying for». vii тақырыбы аурулар туралы: ол басқа абзацта айтылады, B абзацында жоқ.
explanation.ru: Первое же предложение задаёт тему: «The main reason cities count trees today is money», а дальше весь абзац — про ценность деревьев и бюджет → ii «worth paying for». Заголовок vii про болезни взят из другого абзаца и в B не встречается.

items.quote: The traditional method of gathering the data has changed little in a hundred years.

explanation.en: The paragraph is built on a contrast: “The traditional method…” and then “Newer techniques promise to speed this up”. That is exactly “old and new ways of gathering the data” → iv. Heading v, about volunteers, belongs to paragraph D, and even there they do not replace anyone.
explanation.kk: Абзац қарама-қарсы қоюға құрылған: «The traditional method…», одан кейін «Newer techniques promise to speed this up». Бұл — «old and new ways of gathering the data» → iv. v тақырыбы еріктілер туралы — ол D абзацына қатысты, әрі онда еріктілер ешкімді алмастырмайды.
explanation.ru: Абзац строится на контрасте: «The traditional method…» и дальше «Newer techniques promise to speed this up». Это и есть «old and new ways of gathering the data» → iv. Заголовок v про волонтёров — это абзац D, и там они никого не заменяют.

items.quote: Once an inventory exists, it usually reveals two things a city did not know about itself.

explanation.en: “it usually reveals two things a city did not know about itself” — the paragraph is about what the numbers show → vi. Elm disease (vii) is a single example, and its cost is never mentioned, so that heading is far too narrow.
explanation.kk: «it usually reveals two things a city did not know about itself» — абзац сандар нені көрсететіні туралы → vi. Шегіршін ауруы (vii) бір мысал ретінде ғана айтылады, оның шығыны туралы ештеңе жоқ — тақырып тым тар.
explanation.ru: «it usually reveals two things a city did not know about itself» — абзац о том, что показывают цифры → vi. Болезнь вязов (vii) упомянута одним примером, и про её стоимость нет ни слова — заголовок слишком узкий.

groups.instruction: The text has six paragraphs, A–F. Choose the correct heading for paragraphs B, C and E from the list of headings below. Write the correct number, i–viii.

items.quote: once a ledger was complete it was rarely updated
items.prompt: The earliest European tree records were kept up to date for many years.

explanation.en: The text says the opposite: “once a ledger was complete it was rarely updated”. The statement contradicts the text → FALSE, not NOT GIVEN: there is information about updating.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде керісінше айтылған: «once a ledger was complete it was rarely updated». Тұжырым мәтінге қайшы → FALSE. NOT GIVEN емес: жаңарту туралы ақпарат бар.
explanation.ru: В тексте прямо противоположное: «once a ledger was complete it was rarely updated». Утверждение противоречит тексту → FALSE, а не NOT GIVEN: информация об обновлении есть.

items.quote: a city that keeps a record of when each tree was last inspected can show in court that it took reasonable care
items.prompt: A tree inventory can help a city defend itself against legal claims.

explanation.en: “can show in court that it took reasonable care” is the same idea in different words: “legal claims” = “court”, “defend itself” = “show … that it took reasonable care” → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «can show in court that it took reasonable care» — дәл сол қорғану, тек басқа сөздермен: «legal claims» = «court», «defend itself» = «show … that it took reasonable care» → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «can show in court that it took reasonable care» — это и есть защита от претензий, только другими словами: «legal claims» = «court», «defend itself» = «show … that it took reasonable care» → TRUE.

items.quote: they identify the canopy, not the species
items.prompt: Laser scanning from a vehicle can tell which species a tree belongs to.

explanation.en: Laser scanners are in the text, but of them it says: “they identify the canopy, not the species”. The word “not” makes the statement false → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Лазерлік сканерлер мәтінде бар, бірақ олар туралы «they identify the canopy, not the species» делінген. «not» сөзі тұжырымды жалған етеді → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Лазерные сканеры в тексте есть, но про них сказано: «they identify the canopy, not the species». Слово «not» делает утверждение ложным → FALSE.

items.quote: Volunteers download an app, walk their own street and add each tree they find
items.prompt: Most volunteers stop adding trees to an inventory after their first year.

explanation.en: The text says how volunteers add trees and how accurate their records are. It says nothing about how long they keep taking part → NOT GIVEN. FALSE would need a sentence saying that they continue.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде еріктілердің ағаштарды қалай қосатыны және жазбаларының қаншалықты дәл екені айтылады. Қанша уақыт қатысатыны туралы мәтінде ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN. FALSE деу үшін олардың жалғастыратыны туралы сөйлем керек еді.
explanation.ru: Про волонтёров сказано, как они добавляют деревья и насколько точны их записи. О том, как долго они продолжают участвовать, в тексте нет ни слова → NOT GIVEN. Ответ FALSE требовал бы фразы о том, что они продолжают.

groups.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: the two groups agreed on the species of a tree in about four cases out of five
items.prompt: agreed on the 8 ____ of a tree

explanation.en: “agreed on the species of a tree in about four cases out of five” → species. It is spelled that way in the singular too — “specie” does not exist, and “type” or “kind” is not accepted: the word must come from the text.
explanation.kk: «agreed on the species of a tree in about four cases out of five» → species. Сөз жекеше түрде де осылай жазылады — «specie» деген сөз жоқ. «Type» немесе «kind» есептелмейді: сөз мәтіннен алынуы керек.
explanation.ru: «agreed on the species of a tree in about four cases out of five» → species. Слово пишется только так — «specie» не существует, а «type» или «kind» не засчитают: нужно слово из текста.

items.quote: Condition, however, was a different matter.

explanation.en: “Condition, however, was a different matter” — this is exactly where the groups disagreed → condition. “Health” is nearby and close in meaning, but it is already used at the end of the summary (“assessing its health”), and gap 9 needs the noun from this sentence.
explanation.kk: «Condition, however, was a different matter» — топтар дәл осы жерде келіспеді → condition. «health» сөзі жақын тұр, мағынасы да ұқсас, бірақ ол түйіннің соңында қолданылып қойған («assessing its health»), ал 9-сұрақтың бос орнына осы сөйлемдегі зат есім келеді.
explanation.ru: «Condition, however, was a different matter» — именно здесь группы разошлись → condition. Слово «health» стоит рядом и близко по смыслу, но в конце резюме оно уже использовано («assessing its health»), а в пропуск 9 по грамматике встаёт существительное из этого предложения.

items.quote: volunteers could be relied on for a tree’s location and species
items.prompt: relied on for a tree’s 10 ____ and species

explanation.en: The last sentence of paragraph D: “volunteers could be relied on for a tree’s location and species” → location. The summary repeats the phrase almost word for word, so “position” from paragraph A is not accepted: the word must come from this place.
explanation.kk: D абзацының соңғы сөйлемі: «volunteers could be relied on for a tree’s location and species» → location. Түйін сөйлемді сөзбе-сөз дерлік қайталайды, сондықтан A абзацындағы «position» есептелмейді: сөз осы жерден алынуы керек.
explanation.ru: Последнее предложение абзаца D: «volunteers could be relied on for a tree’s location and species» → location. Резюме повторяет фразу почти дословно, поэтому «position» из абзаца A не засчитают: нужно слово из этого места.

groups.title: Volunteer and professional records
groups.summary: In one study, volunteer and professional records agreed on the 8 ____ of a tree in about four cases out of five, and their trunk measurements were close. The biggest disagreement concerned the 9 ____ of the trees, which volunteers tended to judge more generously. The researchers concluded that volunteers could be relied on for a tree’s 10 ____ and species, but not for assessing its health.
groups.instruction: Complete the summary below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the text for each answer.

items.quote: no more than 10% of a city’s trees should belong to one species
items.prompt: According to foresters, what is the largest share of a city’s trees that should belong to a single species?

explanation.en: The paragraph gives three numbers in a row: 10% for a species, 20% for a genus, 30% for a family. The question asks about a “single species” → 10%. “20%” and “30%” are the usual trap of neighbouring figures.
explanation.kk: Абзацта қатарынан үш сан тұр: 10% — түр (species), 20% — туыс, 30% — тұқымдас. Сұрақ «single species» туралы → 10%. «20%» пен «30%» — көрші тұрған сандардың әдеттегі тұзағы.
explanation.ru: В абзаце три числа подряд: 10% — вид (species), 20% — род, 30% — семейство. Вопрос про «single species» → 10%. «20%» и «30%» — типичная ловушка с соседними цифрами.

groups.instruction: Answer the question below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for your answer.

items.quote: a city can plan new planting in the districts that have the fewest trees and reduce its dependence on the species it has too many of
items.prompt: Which TWO of the following does the writer say an inventory allows a city to do?

options.text: plant new trees where there are currently few
require the owners of private gardens to plant trees
rely less on the species it already has too many of
remove every diseased tree within a single year
reduce the cost of laser scanning

explanation.en: The last sentence of paragraph E names exactly two actions: “plan new planting in the districts that have the fewest trees” (A) and “reduce its dependence on the species it has too many of” (C). B contradicts paragraph F (private gardens are not counted); D and E are not in the text. A third letter scores zero for the question.
explanation.kk: E абзацының соңғы сөйлемі дәл екі әрекетті атайды: «plan new planting in the districts that have the fewest trees» (A) және «reduce its dependence on the species it has too many of» (C). B — F абзацына қайшы (жеке бақтар есепке кірмейді), D мен E мәтінде айтылмайды. Үшінші әріп сұрақты 0 баллға түсіреді.
explanation.ru: Последнее предложение абзаца E называет ровно два действия: «plan new planting in the districts that have the fewest trees» (A) и «reduce its dependence on the species it has too many of» (C). B противоречит абзацу F (частные сады в учёт не входят), D и E в тексте не упомянуты. Третья буква обнуляет вопрос.
